greeting: Ataniup atianut, Ataatap, Irniup, ammalu Anirniup Ilangajup. Ullaakkut, ilagiit, quviasungnirmik katimajugut tusarumalluta Guutiup uqausianik.
penitential: Ataniq, nalligittigut. Kirisituusi, nalligittigut. Ataniq, nalligittigut.
psalm_response: Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti!
homily:
Isumagilauruk una takujassaq: Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna qunganninga, taanna qunganninga, ilagiinut takujauvaktuq. Benjamin Vo-p inuusia, taanna masterpiece-ngulluni, uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Isumagilauruk Benjamin-up inuusia, taanna 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani: silatualuuniranga, mathematics-mi pialuktuuninga, coding-mi ammalu technology-mi qaujimaninga. Taakkua pitsiaqtut, silataani qaumajut. Kisiani, Benjamin-up inuusia sanningajuup ujaqqatut tomb-tut ippunngilaq. Ben-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart.

Paulus Sivulliq Reading-mi uqaqpuq: 'Run so as to win.' Una uqausiq uummammiittuq. Benjamin Vo-p inuusia, taanna masterpiece-ngulluni. In the mind of Christ, Ben-up inuusia complete-ngulluni, uummataup salumajunianik ammalu asijinik asujinik tatatitaulluni. Suli qaujimajavut Benjamin-up piggy bank-nganik, taanna offer-nga uncle William-mut. Ben-up piggy bank-nga aksuurniqanngilaq, kisiani uummatikkut pilaurpuq. Benjamin-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart.

Alan ammalu Thao, ilissi uqumaittumik cross-mik tigumiavusi. 15-nik ukiuqaqtilluni Benjamin nuulaurmat, illu nipiqanngippallaarami uummammi aaniarnartuq saqqiqattarpuq. Issiarvik inuqanngittuq nirivingmi… Benjamin-up qunganninga, nipingalu tusaassaarutilimat illumi… Nallunngituugaluaq, qatanngutikka, uqumaittumi aaniarnirmi, uummavut qiaisinamat, taaqtuq isuma saqquqtisarpaa. Do not rush past the wound. The silence in the house is real. Kisiani, Jiisusiup nipinga uqaqpuq: 'Why do you notice the splinter in your brother's eye, but do not perceive the wooden beam in your own?'

Jiisusiup authority-nganik uqaqpuq, iluaniittuq inuusiq. Jiisusiup authority-nga peace-mik, restoring life, lifting up those who are bowed down, as Psalm 84 says today: 'The LORD withholds no good thing from those who walk in sincerity.'

Benjamin Vo, inuusiqaqluni, inuit takulaurtangit silataani: silatualuuniranga, mathematics-mi pialuktuuninga, coding-mi ammalu technology-mi qaujimaninga. Taakkua pitsiaqtut, silataani qaumajut. Kisiani, Benjamin-up inuusia sanningajuup ujaqqatut tomb-tut ippunngilaq. Ben-up uummanga light-vallaalaurpuq, open-vallaalaurpuq, free-vallaalaurpuq. Ben-up uummanga walk-laurpuq Ataniup aqqutingitigut with a pure, simple heart.

Ryan, my dear younger brother, Ben's best friend. You stood beside Ben in front of the cockpit display at the museum; you sat beside him on the bench at the laundromat; you stood beside him outside Phở 54 in your scout uniforms. Ryan, Ben loved you with all his heart. You were his partner in adventure, his brother, his daily companion. When you miss him, when the house feels too quiet, remember that Ben's mind and heart were deeply bonded to yours. You carry Ben's memory inside you. Live your life fully, Ryan! Study hard, play, laugh, explore tech or aviation or whatever brings you joy, knowing that your big brother Ben is cheering you on from heaven's best vantage point.

To all aunts, uncles, grandparents, cousins, and friends who loved Benjamin: Ben's life illuminated what it means to be truly wise. He was brilliant in math and computer logic, yet he was humble, respectful, and sweet-natured. He showed us that real intelligence is never loud or boastful; real intelligence is gentle, generous, and full of love.

To everyone tuning in from afar—especially families who are carrying heavy crosses, parents who grieve, and children who are suffering in hospitals or homes: You are seen by God. The Gospel reminds us today that Jesus' authority is not a heavy hand that crushes us, but a loving hand that heals, sets free, and restores. The Lord is just in all His ways, gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and full of great kindness. He lifts up all who are falling and raises up all who are bowed down.

Benjamin Vo is now in that Banquet, standing beside Saint Carlo Acutis. Two brilliant, modern boys who loved technology, who loved the world, but who loved God more. They are not dead; they are more alive than we are. They are soaring in the light of the Father, free from all weight, breathing the pure air of heaven. Ben's legacy continues to flow on earth, like the clean, life-sustaining water from the 'Giếng Gioan Baotixita' well dedicated in his name in Cà Mau, Vietnam. His middle name, Đại Dương—Great Ocean—remains a sign of God's limitless mercy flowing to those in need.

What can we carry out the door today? Today, when you encounter a complex problem, or when your heart feels overwhelmed by sadness, take a slow breath and remember Saint Paul's words: 'Run so as to win.' Stop seeking answers only in human logic or earthly worry. Turn your mind to Jesus. Look up at the sky, just like Ben loved to watch airplanes soar into the clouds, and remember that God's authority is peace, God's Word is love, and Benjamin Vo is safe in the Father's eternal embrace. Let us pray: 'Lord Jesus Christ, You spoke with authority in the synagogue and brought peace to the hearts of all. Grant us the mind of Christ, that we may see beyond earthly tears into the eternal light of Your Kingdom. Comfort Alan, Thao, and Ryan with Your deep peace. Hold Benjamin Đại Dương Vo close in Your heavenly joy until we all meet again at Your eternal Banquet. Amen.'
spiritual_communion: Jiisusi, uqaqtuq, 'I am the bread of life.' Uummama iluani, tatigijara ilvit, Jiisusi. Ilvit uummammiittut, uummama iluani, qanittumik. Amen.
closing: Ataniup angirutinga ilissingnut aqqutaujuq. Ataniq ikajurli ilissinik, quviasungnirmik ammalu nalliginnirmik.
standing_petitions: Benjamin Vo ammalu tamaita inuujunnaqtuut, Ataniup qaumangani qasuqattarli.
Tamaita uqumaittumik aaniartut ammalu qiajut, Guutiup nalligittigut ammalu quviasungnirmik tunilugit.

readings.label: Reading 1
readings.text: Qatanngutikka: Gospel-mik uqalaurama, tamanna quviasugutiunngilaq, uqumaittumik uqausiqtaqaramali, ammalu aaniarnartuq uqalunngikkuma! Pijumallunga uqalauruma, akiliutigijara taanna, kisiani pijumangikkuma, stewardship-ngulluni. Qanuq akiliutigijara? Gospel-mik uqausiqtara akiliqtuqtaunani, Gospel-mi pijunnautinik atunngillunga. Ilittunga inuujunga tamainnut, kisiani tamainnut kingujaulaurpunga, inuit amiqutillugit. Tamainnut inuujunga, ilait inuujutitillugit. Tamanna pijara Gospel-mut, ilittunga ilauqataulungama. Qaujimaviuk unatarviit, inuit tamaita arjurtut, kisiani atausiq atausiungmiutut? Arjurit inuujutitillugit. Tamaita arjurtut aksuurniqattartut. Taakkua inuujutitillugit, kisiani uagut inuujutitilluta. Taanna pijara, arjurnngillunga; shadowbox-ngillunga. No, body-ra aksuurniqattartara, uqalaurama inuit, ilittunga disqualification-ngullunga.

readings.label: Responsorial Psalm
readings.text: R. Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti! Uummara nalligittuq Ataniup najuganganut. Uummara ammalu flesh-ra cry-tuq inuujumut Guutimut. R. Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti! Sparrow-nguup najugavinga nani, ammalu swallow-nguup nest-nga, irniangit najugavinga—Ataniup altars-ngit, Ataniq, king-ra ammalu Guuti! R. Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti! Blessed-nguujut najugavittit! Continually praise-tuq. Blessed-nguujut sanngijungit! Pilgrimage-ngulluni. R. Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti! Sun ammalu shield-ngulluni Ataniq Guuti; grace ammalu glory-ngulluni; Ataniup withhold-ngittuq piujumik walk-tuunut sincerity-mi. R. Qanuq piujutigivaa najugavit, Ataniq, sanngijuq Guuti!

readings.label: Gospel
readings.text: Jiisusi uqalaurpuq disciples-minut parable-mik: 'Blind-nguup blind-nguup guider-nguuk? Tamarmik pit-mut tusaajauvut? Disciples-nguup teacher-nguup superior-ngunngilaq; kisiani trained-nguulluni, disciple-nguup teacher-nguup ilunganiittuq. Qanuq splinter-mik brother-nguup eye-ngani, beam-nguup eye-ngani? Qanuq uqautivik brother-nguup, 'Brother, splinter-mik remove-tullugu,' beam-nguup eye-ngani? Hypocrite! Remove-tullugu beam-nguup eye-ngani; taanna clear-ngulluni remove-tullugu splinter-mik brother-nguup eye-ngani.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-third Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - need a miracle here. We miss you so much and we’re not sleeping much. Ryan wish you were here, especially this upcoming Saturday to play the new version of Project Flight with him.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Dear Ben, our uncle Thanh has passed away. Please watch over him and pray that his soul finds peace. His saint name is Phêrô. Lord, thank you for sending Chu Thanh into my life. I'll always be grateful for the time he spent tutoring me in math back in high school

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: can't stop thinking about you Ben... wishing i could go back into time and try to change things around... maybe spend more time with you and less working so much. Please pray for me and mom.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you Ben - haven't been able to sleep much these days. Please stop by to say hi whenever you're able to. Love you
